intent_text: Improve docstring for GraphQL refreshToken mutation (#12613) * Improve docstring for GraphQL refreshToken mutation This improves the auto-generated documentation at https://docs.saleor.io/docs/3.x/api-reference/authentication/mutations/token-refresh by removing a out of the place or accidental `-` and will format variable names and cookie name as inline code (`<code>`). * Format csrfToken variable as inline-code * Add missing space in docstring
